import 'package:napi/napi.dart';

typedef Count = int;
typedef Id<T> = T;
typedef Mapper = R Function<R extends num>(R value);

/// Generic types and named parameters survive discovery.
@NAPI()
Map<String, List<T?>>? describe<T extends num>(
  T value, {
  required int count,
  String? label = 'hello',
  void Function(int, {String? label})? callback,
}) => null;

@NAPI()
T documented<
  /// The documented type parameter.
  T extends Object
>(
  /// The documented value parameter.
  T value,
) => value;

@NAPI()
int optionalValues(int value, [int count = 7, int? nullable]) => value;

@NAPI()
int explicitNull({int? value = null}) => value ?? 0;

@NAPI()
Count countAlias(Count value) => value;

@NAPI()
Id<int> genericAlias(Id<int> value) => value;

@NAPI()
double floatingPoint(double value) => value;

@NAPI()
Mapper genericCallback(Mapper mapper) => mapper;

@NAPI()
void separateCallbacks(
  T Function<T extends num>(T value) first,
  T Function<T extends num>(T value) second,
) {}

@NAPI()
(int, {String? label, double weight})? recordValue(
  (int, {String? label, double weight})? value,
) => value;

@NAPI()
dynamic dynamicValue(dynamic value) => value;

@NAPI()
void voidValue() {}

@NAPI()
Never neverValue() => throw StateError('never');

@NAPI()
Future<int> asyncValue() async => 1;

@NAPI()
Iterable<int> generatorValue() sync* {
  yield 1;
}

@NAPI()
external int externalValue(int value);

class Base {
  final int inherited;
  const Base({this.inherited = 1});
  void inheritedMethod() {}
}

mixin Feature {
  void mixedInMethod() {}
}

abstract interface class Sized {
  int get size;
}

/// A generic class retains its own public members.
@NAPI(name: 'Box')
class Container<T extends num> extends Base with Feature implements Sized {
  /// The primary constructor.
  @NAPI(name: 'create')
  Container(this.value, {super.inherited = 1});

  Container.named(this.value);

  factory Container.empty(T value) => Container(value);

  /// The stored payload.
  @NAPI(name: 'payload')
  final T value;

  late String lazy;
  static const int limit = 4;
  double ratio = 1.5;

  @NAPI(exclude: true)
  void ignored() {}

  @NAPI(name: 'mapValue')
  R map<R extends Object>(R Function(T) transform) => transform(value);

  @NAPI(name: 'nullable')
  T? get nullableValue => value;
  @NAPI(name: 'nullable')
  set nullableValue(T? value) {}

  static int twice(int value) => value * 2;

  @NAPI(name: 'ignored')
  void visible() {}

  @NAPI(name: 'shared')
  void instanceScope() {}
  @NAPI(name: 'shared')
  static void staticScope() {}

  Container<T> operator +(Container<T> other) => this;
  Future<int> asyncMethod() async => 1;
  Iterable<int> generatorMethod() sync* {
    yield 1;
  }

  @override
  int get size => 1;

  void assign(covariant Object value) {}
  void _privateMethod() {}
  int get _privateGetter => 0;
}

@NAPI()
final class Immutable {
  const Immutable(this.value);
  final int value;
}

@NAPI()
abstract class AbstractValue {
  int get value;
  external void externalMethod();
}

@NAPI()
class ImplicitConstructor {}

@NAPI()
abstract base class BaseFlag {}

@NAPI()
sealed class SealedFlag {}

@NAPI()
abstract interface class InterfaceFlag {}

@NAPI()
mixin class MixinFlag {}

enum Choice { first }
extension type Wrapped(int value) {}

@NAPI()
Choice choiceValue(Choice value) => value;

@NAPI()
Feature? mixinValue(Feature? value) => value;

@NAPI()
Wrapped extensionValue(Wrapped value) => value;

@NAPI()
class Combined = Base with Feature;

@NAPI()
int wildcardValues(int _, int _, int p0) => p0;

class CallbackBase<T> {}
mixin CallbackMixin<T> {}
abstract interface class CallbackInterface<T> {}

@NAPI()
class CallbackOwner extends CallbackBase<T Function<T>(T)>
    with CallbackMixin<T Function<T>(T)>
    implements CallbackInterface<T Function<T>(T)> {}

@NAPI()
class OtherCallbackOwner extends CallbackBase<T Function<T>(T)> {}

@NAPI()
class GenericWildcards<_, _> {}

@NAPI()
void genericWildcards<_, _>() {}

@NAPI()
void wildcardCallback(void Function<_, _>() callback) {}
